allow: PowerShell($latest = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/ArtifexSoftware/ghostpdl-downloads/releases/latest" -Headers @{ "User-Agent" = "claude-code" }; Write-Output "Tag: $\($latest.tag_name\)"; $latest.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -match "w64.exe$" -and $_.name -notmatch "gpcl|gpdl" } | Select-Object name, browser_download_url, @{N="MB";E={[math]::Round\($_.size/1MB,1\)}})
